title: Securities Exchange Act 1934 (Luật Giao dịch Chứng khoán 1934)

versions.text: Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 USC §78a et seq.). Governs secondary trading of securities. §10(b): Manipulative and deceptive devices (Rule 10b-5). §13: Reporting requirements. §14: Proxies. §16: Short-swing profits. §21D: Private Securities Litigation Reform Act.
